name: Price Statistics & Index Numbers
description: Official price indices, Consumer Price Index (CPI), index formulation methods (Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher), inflation analytics, and deflation under MoSPI statistical guidelines.
authority: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
standard: National Statistical Commission (NSC) Index Number Guidelines

skills.name: Price Relative Calculation
skills.description: Calculate price relative as ratio of current period price to base period price expressed as percentage.

skills.name: Commodity Basket Weight Normalization
skills.description: Normalize consumption expenditure weights across commodities to sum to 100 or 1.0.

skills.name: CPI via Weighted Average of Price Relatives
skills.description: Calculate Consumer Price Index as the weighted arithmetic mean of individual commodity price relatives.

skills.name: Inflation Rate Computation
skills.description: Calculate percentage rate of inflation between two successive periods from index values.

skills.name: Laspeyres Price Index
skills.description: Calculate Laspeyres fixed-base weighted price index using base period quantities as weights.

skills.name: Paasche Price Index
skills.description: Calculate Paasche price index using current period quantities as dynamic weights.

skills.name: Fisher Ideal Price Index
skills.description: Calculate Fisher ideal index as the geometric mean of Laspeyres and Paasche price indices.

skills.name: Real vs Nominal Value Deflation
skills.description: Compute real value (constant price) from nominal value using price deflator/CPI.
